analyst_view.overall: Early view: Vitória are 14th with 9 points, a poor start for a young squad under summer appointment Tiago Margarido, so they need a home win. Alverca have lost three of their last four league games and play Moreirense at home on Monday 7 December. Vitória are listed without centre-back Toni Borevkovic, who faces a ban for five yellow cards.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. Vitória are listed without centre-back Toni Borevkovic, a regular starter, and need to chase a win at home, which should open the game up a little. I lean slightly higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. Vitória should have most of the ball at home, but against Porto they switched to a direct, long-ball game in the second half, which does not always win corners. I keep it level.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards. Vitória played a physical second half against Porto and picked up two bookings in one minute, one for arguing, but the referee is not known yet. I stay with the number for now.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.4 shots, most of them from Vitória. A home side short of points with a weakened back line tends to make for a more open game with chances at both ends. I lean a little higher.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.8 shots on target. Vitória managed only one on target in the first half against Porto, so more shots do not always mean more on target. I keep it level.
